newsitem.title: USA: Indiana corn 38 percent mature versus 61 pct avg.
newsitem.headline: Indiana corn 38 percent mature versus 61 pct avg.

text.p: Thirty-eight percent of Indiana's corn crop was mature as of Sunday, below 74 percent a year ago and below the 61 percent average as of Sunday, according to the Indiana Agricultural Statistics Service.
Three percent of the crop was harvested, below 11 percent a year ago and below the nine percent average.
Soybeans were one percent harvested, below eight percent a year ago and below the nine percent average pace.
Eight percent of the soybean crop was mature, below 39 percent a year ago and below 39 percent average.
Winter wheat was four percent planted.
The wheat planting pace was equal to the four percent of a year ago and below the five percent average.
Corn was four percent very poor, 13 percent poor, 39 percent fair, 41 percent good and three percent excellent.
Soybeans were four percent very poor, 17 percent poor, 40 percent fair, 37 percent good and two percent excellent.
Pasture conditions were eight percent very poor, 22 percent poor, 45 percent fair and 25 percent good.
